name: software-notion
description: Game data from the Software Notion companion apps and matching app recommendations for games and everyday tasks.

interface.longDescription:
Software Notion builds companion apps for popular video games, with interactive offline maps, collectible checklists and game databases, as well as apps for everyday work.

With this app, ChatGPT can look up facts from the data behind the Software Notion companion apps and use them in its answers:
• what exists in a game and in which region: shrines, Korok seeds, sites of grace, bosses, quests and other collectibles
• items, weapons, armor, enemies, monsters, skills and recipes, including short descriptions and key values
• official in-game names in up to 20 languages, for example German, French, Japanese or Chinese

Supported games:
• The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, Tears of the Kingdom, Echoes of Wisdom, Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask, A Link to the Past, Link's Awakening, The Wind Waker, Twilight Princess, Skyward Sword and the original NES game
• Elden Ring with Shadow of the Erdtree and Nightreign
• Monster Hunter Wilds
• Palworld
• Pokémon Legends: Z-A
• Horizon Zero Dawn, Horizon Forbidden West and Horizon Call of the Mountain
• Ghost of Yōtei
• The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
• Crimson Desert
• Super Mario Odyssey
• Mario Kart World
• Donkey Kong Bananza

Free web apps that run in the browser, for older games:
• Monster Hunter: World with Iceborne and Monster Hunter Rise with Sunbreak
• Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, Pokémon Legends: Arceus and a Pokédex for the main Pokémon games
• Assassin's Creed Valhalla

When it helps, ChatGPT shows the matching companion app as a card with links to the App Store and Google Play, or to the web app. Exact map positions, screenshots, checklists and progress tracking are available in the apps themselves.

The app can also point to Software Notion apps for other tasks:
• documentation in community-based youth and family services (Focus Family)
• German postal codes (PLZ Suche)
• WoW Token prices

All tools are read-only. There is no account and no sign-in, and tool requests are not stored. The game companion apps are unofficial fan apps and are not affiliated with the game publishers.
capabilities: Look up locations, collectibles, items, enemies and quests in supported games
Return official in-game names in the user's language
Show the matching Software Notion app with download or web app links
List all supported games and apps
defaultPrompt: Where are the Korok seeds in Akkala in Tears of the Kingdom?
Which elements is Rathalos weak to in Monster Hunter Wilds?
Which Software Notion apps are there for Zelda games?

positive.prompt: Where can I find Korok seeds in Akkala in Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_game_data for Tears of the Kingdom and lists Korok seeds in Akkala with their short hints. Mentions that the Tears Companion app has the exact map positions.

positive.prompt: Which elements is Rathalos weak to in Monster Hunter Wilds and what materials does it drop?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_game_data for Monster Hunter Wilds and answers that Rathalos is weakest to Dragon and Thunder, then lists drop materials such as Rathalos Scale+ and Rathalos Ruby. Invents no drop rates.

positive.description: German question with official German names
positive.prompt: Wo finde ich in Elden Ring den Ort der Gnade „Vor dem Tor“ und was ist in der Nähe?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_game_data with language de, answers in German with the official German names (Vor dem Tor, Ruinen vor dem Tor) and says the site of grace is in Limgrave.

positive.prompt: Is there an app with an offline map and checklists for Breath of the Wild?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_software_notion_app and shows the Breath Companion card with its features and App Store and Google Play buttons.

positive.description: Web app for an older game
positive.prompt: Is there an app with a set builder for Monster Hunter: World?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_software_notion_app and shows the MHW Companion card with a single Web App button. Says it is a free web app that runs in the browser and shows no App Store or Google Play links.

positive.prompt: I work in community-based youth welfare (ambulante Jugendhilfe). Is there an app for case documentation and help plan meetings?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_software_notion_app and shows the Focus Family card with documentation, help plan and time tracking features.

negative.prompt: Recommend a good movie for tonight.
Where do I find diamonds in Minecraft?

negative.description: Write action that the app does not support
negative.prompt: Mark all shrines in Breath Companion as completed for me.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything and does not process payments. It only shows links to app store listings and free web apps of Software Notion.

publication.release_notes: Adds the free Software Notion web apps that run in the browser: Monster Hunter: World, Monster Hunter Rise, Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, Pokémon Legends: Arceus, a Pokédex for the main Pokémon games and Assassin's Creed Valhalla. App cards for these games link to the web app instead of the app stores.
